name: Sesame-Crusted Tuna Sashimi / Ahi Tuna Poke (Night 2)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Disney Magic · Animator's Palate (Animation Magic Night 2)
whyItWorks: Sushi-grade raw/seared ahi tuna is ultra-lean protein, though the sesame crust, wakame seaweed salad, and ponzu dressing require modification.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Request the tuna sashimi plain with regular soy sauce (no citrus ponzu, no spicy mayo, and scrape off heavy sesame seeds if flaring).
watchOuts: Sesame seed crust and fibrous wakame seaweed salad
